summary: Iteration 45 retest (fix-validation for iteration 44 CRITICAL consent-withdraw read bug, + frontend regression now that preview is awake). Backend: 13/13 pytest pass (10 regression + 3 new). The consent grant/withdraw/regrant cycle on partner_sharing now returns the correct latest status on every read; event_ts is populated on both paths; the COALESCE(granted_at, withdrawn_at) fallback correctly handles pre-fix legacy rows. Immutable ledger verified (N+1 rows after each event). Frontend: actionable-portfolio-view, cat-rank pills (#N/M format, hover titles, colour-map thresholds), star-rating (stars-N testid), filter-WEAK, CSV export, cta-alert-diversification→filter-WEAK, portfolio-header, impact-strip, asset-tabs, action badges (64), inline switches (7), refresh scores — all working. Minor: one MF cat-rank title falls back to 'in category' because that holding has no `category` field from backend.

issues: One observed holding's tooltip reads 'Rank 11 of 14 in category (by V3 Quality)' (fallback string) instead of the actual category name — root cause: backend did not populate `category` on that MF's holdings-enriched payload. Not a UI bug per-se, but surfaces a data-hygiene gap in services/portfolio_enrichment.py for the affected fund.

action_items: (Optional, low priority) Backfill or guarantee non-null `category` on every MF holdings-enriched row so the cat-rank pill tooltip never falls back to the literal 'category'. Check services/portfolio_enrichment.py category lookup path.
critical_code_review_comments: services/consents.py::current_for_user — fix verified: now sorts in Python by `event_ts or withdrawn_at or granted_at or ''`, DESC. Robust to both new rows (event_ts present) and legacy rows (fall back to coalesced timestamp). Withdraw path writes event_ts=withdrawn_at; grant writes event_ts=granted_at. Ledger stays immutable (new row per event).

ActionablePortfolioView.js cat-rank colour-map verified against spec. Uses Math.ceil thresholds: rank<=ceil(total*0.1)=emerald, <=ceil(total*0.25)=lime, <=ceil(total*0.5)=amber, else rose. Observed: #17/17→rose✓, #11/14→rose✓, #2/5→lime (correct because ceil(5*0.25)=2).
StarRating testid is `stars-{value}` (0..5), not `star-rating-*` — main agent naming is consistent inside the component. Confirmed 8 star elements rendered on portfolio table for MF rows.

Console warnings on page load: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle' and 'Missing Description or aria-describedby' from shadcn Dialog — a11y nit, not a functional blocker. Likely in ActionPlanManager or a similar modal — consider wrapping with VisuallyHidden DialogTitle.
CSV export downloads `nivesh_portfolio_2026-04-23.csv` correctly. cta-alert-diversification properly toggles filter-WEAK active (bg-slate-900 text-white).
